title: Short-term reversal, one month
author: arhancanli
rationale: Holds the stocks that fell most over the past month. A sharp short move can come from someone needing to trade rather than from news, and such moves can partly undo themselves.
risks: It buys what has just fallen, and a fall can be for a good reason. Turnover is very high, so costs and the gap between bid and ask can take most of any effect.
references: Jegadeesh (1990), Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns, Journal of Finance
Lehmann (1990), Fads, Martingales, and Market Efficiency, Quarterly Journal of Economics
